en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Ibrahim, Bin Abu Al Balaad, from Sa’ad Al Askaaf who said, 
‘I have no knowledge of it except that Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said:

‘There used to be a worshipper among the Children of Israel to whom Dawood<sup>as</sup> used to marvel (be amazed) at. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto him<sup>as</sup>: “Do not marvel at anything from his affairs, for he is a show-off”.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So the man died, so they came to Dawood<sup>as</sup> and said to him<sup>as</sup>, ‘The man died’. So Dawood<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Bury your companion’. But, the Children of Israel refused and they said, ‘How come you<sup>as</sup> are not attending it (funeral)?’ 
He<sup>asws</sup> said:

‘So when he had been washed, fifty men arose and testified with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that they did not know from him except for goodness. So when they had Prayed over him, fifty other men arose, so they testified with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that they did not know from his except for the goodness. So when they had buried him, fifty testified with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that they did not know from him except for the goodness’.

So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto Dawood<sup>as</sup>: “What prevented you<sup>as</sup> to testify for so and so?” So Dawood<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! That which You<sup>azwj</sup> Notified me<sup>as</sup> of, from his affairs’.

So Allah <sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto him<sup>as</sup>: “That is like that, but a group of Rabbis and Monks have testified that they do not know from him except for the goodness, so I<sup>azwj</sup> Allowed their testimonies over him, and Forgave for him (whatever was) in My<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge regarding him”.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has narrated the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali, Alayhi al-Salam, issued a judgment. It was in the case of a virgin woman who was accused of fornication. He (the Imam) commanded certain women to examine her. They reported about her to be a virgin.
He (the Imam) issued a judgment that said, ‘I am not to penalize one on whom Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has placed a seal.
He (the Imam) accepted the testimony of women in such cases.”
